tables.grain: 1 row = 1 credit reported by another institution (SK_ID_BUREAU)

columns_detail.name: SK_ID_BUREAU
columns_detail.description: Recoded ID of previous Credit Bureau credit related to our loan (unique coding for each loan application)

columns_detail.name: CREDIT_ACTIVE
columns_detail.description: Status of the Credit Bureau (CB) reported credits

columns_detail.name: DAYS_CREDIT
columns_detail.description: How many days before current application did client apply for Credit Bureau credit

columns_detail.name: CREDIT_DAY_OVERDUE
columns_detail.description: Number of days past due on CB credit at the time of application for related loan in our sample

columns_detail.name: AMT_CREDIT_SUM_DEBT
columns_detail.description: Current debt on Credit Bureau credit

tables.grain: 1 row = 1 bureau credit x 1 month (SK_ID_BUREAU, MONTHS_BALANCE)

columns_detail.name: MONTHS_BALANCE
columns_detail.description: Month of balance relative to application date (-1 means the freshest balance date)

columns_detail.name: STATUS
columns_detail.description: Status of Credit Bureau loan during the month (C closed, X unknown, 0 no DPD, 1 maximal DPD 1-30, ..., 5 120+ or sold/written off)

columns_detail.name: SK_ID_PREV
columns_detail.description: ID of previous credit in Home credit related to loan in our sample

columns_detail.name: NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS
columns_detail.description: Contract status (approved, cancelled, ...) of previous application

columns_detail.name: DAYS_DECISION
columns_detail.description: Relative to current application when was the decision about previous application made

tables.grain: 1 row = 1 payment record of 1 installment of a previous loan (an installment can have several partial-payment rows)

columns_detail.name: DAYS_INSTALMENT
columns_detail.description: When the installment of previous credit was supposed to be paid (relative to application date of current loan)

columns_detail.name: DAYS_ENTRY_PAYMENT
columns_detail.description: When was the installments of previous credit paid actually (relative to application date of current loan)

columns_detail.name: AMT_INSTALMENT
columns_detail.description: What was the prescribed installment amount of previous credit on this installment

columns_detail.name: AMT_PAYMENT
columns_detail.description: What the client actually paid on previous credit on this installment

tables.grain: 1 row = 1 previous POS/cash loan x 1 month (SK_ID_PREV, MONTHS_BALANCE)

columns_detail.name: MONTHS_BALANCE
columns_detail.description: Month of balance relative to application date (-1 means the information to the freshest monthly snapshot)

columns_detail.name: SK_DPD
columns_detail.description: DPD (days past due) during the month of previous credit

tables.grain: 1 row = 1 previous credit card x 1 month (SK_ID_PREV, MONTHS_BALANCE)

columns_detail.name: AMT_BALANCE
columns_detail.description: Balance during the month of previous credit

columns_detail.name: AMT_CREDIT_LIMIT_ACTUAL
columns_detail.description: Credit card limit during the month of the previous credit

columns_detail.name: SK_DPD
columns_detail.description: DPD (Days past due) during the month on the previous credit
